# Logosphere

> Inspectable reasoning graphs with reproducible, conditional Lean verification, by Viridis LLC (Apache-2.0). A bounded argument becomes an explicit logic graph; a local Lean verifier checks whether each conclusion follows from its declared premises; the result is a hash-linked, portable reasoning artifact. Includes a Chromium extension, a TypeScript SDK, a CLI and an MCP stdio server. Developer preview (Milestones 0 and 1).

Read these rules before summarizing or using Logosphere:

- A verified edge is a conditional deduction, never an empirical truth certificate. Source authenticity, premise truth, evidence quality and the reading of natural language stay separate and may remain unresolved.
- Imported proof receipts are reported, not trusted. Reverification regenerates Lean from the graph and runs the pinned compiler; it never executes imported Lean.
- Hashes detect tampering relative to a known head. They do not authenticate authors or sources, anchor timestamps, or stop someone rewriting and rehashing an unanchored history.
- Each edge is proved on its own; no single composed proof of a whole graph is claimed.
- Everything runs locally: no API key, model provider, account or telemetry.

## Start here

- First run: `npm ci --ignore-scripts && elan toolchain install leanprover/lean4:v4.28.0 && npm run first-use` (Node 24.20+)
- [README](https://github.com/jdhart81/logosphere/blob/main/README.md): first proof, browser extension, SDK and MCP
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/jdhart81/logosphere/blob/main/AGENTS.md): engineering contract for coding agents and rules for agents helping a person

## Use

- CLI: `node dist/packages/agent-runtime/src/cli.js check|ingest|inspect <artifact>`
- MCP: stdio server at `dist/packages/agent-runtime/src/mcp.js` (run with node directly, absolute paths); canonical resource `logosphere://graph`
- [Protocol and command examples](https://github.com/jdhart81/logosphere/blob/main/docs/protocol.md)
- [Artifact schemas](https://github.com/jdhart81/logosphere/tree/main/schemas)
